title: Silhouette Eclipse Over City
description: A massive dark silhouette of a woman's head and shoulders dominates the surreal scene, her face eclipsed by a glowing yellow moon. Below, numerous black silhouettes of people stand in a reflective body of water in front of a vibrant city skyline at sunset.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a giant black silhouette of a woman's head with long flowing hair dominating the sky, her face covered by a bright yellow full moon. In the foreground, many black silhouette figures of people stand in reflective water, some holding canes, with a detailed city skyline featuring skyscrapers in the background under a vibrant pink, orange and yellow sunset sky with dramatic clouds.
